no-tag-owned-behavior.description: No tag-owned semantic, naming, keyboard, focus, state, announcement, or motion behavior.

transparent-content.description: A transparent wrapper that preserves the semantics and focus behavior of authored descendants.

document-content.description: Rendered document content preserves authored headings, landmarks, links, and reading order.

text-content.description: The rendered value remains ordinary readable text.

animation-content.description: Animation leaves authored content semantics intact and suppresses nonessential motion when requested.

alert.description: An assertive status message is named from its content.

callout.description: A callout preserves the semantics and reading order of its authored content.

reactive-callout.description: Callout content remains readable, gains an optional authored group name, and announces only post-mount content changes.

animated-image.description: A named image exposes an operable playback control and reduced-motion behavior.

named-image.description: Meaningful image content requires an authored accessible alternative.

navigation.description: A named navigation landmark exposes the current destination.

link.description: A named link uses native keyboard activation and focus behavior.

button.description: A named button uses native activation and exposes disabled and pressed state.

button-group.description: Related buttons share an author-provided group name.

carousel.description: A named carousel provides one keyboard navigation stop, slide state, and change announcements.

carousel-item.description: A carousel item exposes its selected position within the authored slide set.

checkbox.description: A labelled checkbox exposes checked, required, invalid, and disabled state.

checkbox-group.description: Independent checkboxes share a labelled and described grouping.

color-picker.description: A labelled color field and palette expose editable value, swatch names, selection, and dismissal behavior.

copy-button.description: A named copy action announces success or failure after activation.

disclosure.description: A heading-aligned disclosure button exposes expanded and disabled state.

accordion.description: An accordion coordinates disclosure headings with roving arrow-key navigation.

modal.description: A named modal overlay traps initial focus, dismisses with Escape, and returns focus.

separator.description: A separator exposes its orientation without adding a keyboard stop.

menu-button.description: A named trigger exposes menu expansion and returns focus after dismissal.

icon.description: Unlabelled icons are presentational; meaningful icons use an authored alternative.

image-comparison.description: A named adjustable divider exposes its numeric position.

text-input.description: A labelled native-like text field exposes editing and form validity.

textarea.description: A labelled multiline field exposes native editing, validity, and optional count updates.

menu.description: A menu uses one roving tab stop with arrow, Home/End, and typeahead navigation.

menuitem.description: A named menu item exposes disabled, checked, selected, and submenu state.

group-label.description: Text labels an adjacent authored group without becoming a control.

option.description: A content-named option exposes disabled and selected state.

positioning-primitive.description: A positioning primitive deliberately supplies no standalone widget semantics or interaction.

progress.description: A named progress indicator exposes determinate value or indeterminate busy state.

qr-image.description: QR output is exposed as a named image rather than raw visual pixels alone.

radio.description: A labelled radio exposes checked, disabled, required, and invalid state.

radio-group.description: A labelled radio group owns one roving tab stop and arrow-key selection.

slider.description: A labelled slider supports range keys and exposes value, orientation, and disabled state.

select.description: A labelled select coordinates a combobox, listbox, and selected options.

decorative-placeholder.description: A loading placeholder remains presentational and suppresses ambient motion.

loading-status.description: A loading placeholder can expose localized busy status and suppress ambient motion.

indeterminate-progress.description: An indeterminate operation is exposed as progress without creating a live status announcement.

localized-indeterminate-progress.description: A non-live indeterminate progressbar has a localized or authored name and suppresses ambient motion.

split-panel.description: An adjustable separator supports range keys and exposes value and orientation.

switch.description: A labelled switch supports native activation and exposes checked and disabled state.

tab.description: A content-named tab exposes selected and disabled state.

tab-group.description: A tablist links tabs to panels with roving navigation and configurable activation.

tab-panel.description: A tab panel is labelled by its owning tab and exposes hidden versus active state.

tag.description: A content-named tag exposes a localized optional remove action.

tooltip.description: Non-interactive descriptive content appears on pointer hover or keyboard focus.

tree.description: A tree uses roving hierarchical navigation and exposes selection and expansion.

treeitem.description: A content-named tree item exposes level, expansion, selection, and disabled state.

visually-hidden.description: Visually hidden content remains in reading order and reveals focused descendants.

chart.description: A named chart exposes a textual data representation alongside the visual rendering.

combobox.description: A labelled editable combobox coordinates textbox, listbox, and selected options.

data-grid.description: A labelled data grid uses roving cell navigation and exposes selection and sorting.

segmented-field.description: A labelled segmented field exposes editable date or time groups and validation.

date-picker.description: A labelled calendar grid uses roving date navigation and exposes selected/current dates.

file-input.description: A labelled native file control exposes selection, removal, and validation state.

number-input.description: A labelled spinbutton supports native editing, stepping, and range validity.

otp-input.description: A labelled one-time-code field presents one editing and form target.

page-landmarks.description: An application page composes named header, navigation, main, and complementary regions.

pagination.description: A named pagination landmark marks the current page, preserves focus, and announces changes.

popover.description: A named non-modal popover dismisses with Escape and returns focus to its trigger.

random-content-upstream.description: Rotating content pauses around pointer/focus interaction, suppresses motion, and announces every selection.

random-content-target.description: Rotating content preserves focused descendants, announces manual changes, and provides a visible pause control.

scroller.description: A labelled overflow region exposes localized keyboard-operable scroll controls.

sparkline.description: A compact chart exposes a textual value and accessible image name.

toast-region.description: A toast region queues status or alert items without moving focus.

video.description: A named video exposes captions and keyboard-operable playback controls.

video-playlist.description: A named video playlist exposes the active item and keyboard selection.

frame.description: An embedded frame requires a title and can deliberately gate keyboard entry.
